profile.headline: Frontend Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m passionate about building high-performing, scalable, and user-centric applications. With 8+ years of experience in front-end development, I specialize in modern web technologies, staying ahead of emerging trends to craft seamless digital experiences.

I thrive at the intersection of engineering and design, ensuring intuitive and efficient user interactions across platforms. Proficient in TypeScript, JavaScript, and GraphQL, I develop robust applications with React, Vue.js, and Node.js. Always optimizing for performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Beyond front-end expertise, I have a strong grasp of backend services, API development, and state management, enabling me to build end-to-end solutions that drive business value. I'm always exploring innovative ways to enhance development workflows and create impactful digital products.

Technical Expertise:
* Frontend: React, Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, GraphQL, Tailwind CSS, Chakra UI, CSS/SCSS/LESS, styled-components, Material UI, GSAP, SVG, Animations
* Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Go
* State Management: Redux, React Query, React hook forms
* Engineering Practices: Unit Testing, Code Reviews, Debugging, Agile/Scrum, Performance Optimization, Problem-Solving, Datadog.
* Tools & Build Systems: Webpack, Vite, Gulp, Jest, Git, Docker
* Design: Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, Zeplin, Photoshop, Illustrator

💡 Always learning, always iterating. Let's build something incredible together!

🔗 Portfolio: https://lisbelcruz.com

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States · Remote

positions.title: Front-end Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed the frontend for a content marketplace and licensing platform, enabling brands to discover and legally license internet content for commercial campaigns.
- Built and optimized highly responsive, performant, and user-friendly web applications using TypeScript, React, RedwoodJS, GraphQL, and CSS in a fast-paced Agile environment.
- Partnered closely with designers, creative technologists, and backend engineers to develop and refine user experiences that drive engagement and revenue.
- Refactored legacy code to align with evolving business needs, improving maintainability, performance, and overall code quality.
- Helped establish a design system by creating reusable components, ensuring UI consistency, and boosting development efficiency.
- Integrated GraphQL to optimize data fetching and improve frontend performance.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to refine requirements, scope projects, and deliver new features iteratively with speed and predictability.
- Participated in sprint planning, code reviews, and brainstorming sessions to maintain high code quality, ensure scalability, and optimize the platform’s performance.
positions.insights: Skills: GraphQL · Front-end Development · React.js · Node.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · Web Development

positions.title: Ad product Developer
positions.description:
- Assist Product Owner in designing and defining new features.
- Collaborate in Research and Development efforts for new ad products and features.
- Work with Architect and Lead Developer to craft technical designs and drive the revolution of products.
- Write code that is of high quality and consistent with coding standards.
- Write automated tests for new features to ensure they are of very high quality (Unit Testing).
- Review the work of other engineers (Code Review).
- Collaborate with the team on defining guidelines and good practices.
- Support Creative Development team doing research and enabling adoption of new technologies.
- Develop features for internal applications using HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Restful API, React and Vue.
- Serve as a member of a Scrum team and participate in all planning, stand-up and meetings.
- Support Creative team with development of campaign needs on an as needed basis with
   collaborative communication on prioritization and deadlines.

positions.title: Senior Ad Developer
positions.description:
- Create engaging experiences for the user like games, custom quiz, interactive media and more.
- Build cross-device advertising using mostly Celtra Ad Creator and Google Web Designer.
- Develop features for internal applications using HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Restful API, React and Vue.
- Maintain reusable repositories components for the mobile creatives.
- Turn design into code.

positions.title: Front End Developer Engineer IV
positions.description:
- Develop a new application from the ground up, transforming an outdated system with modern 
   technology and an upgraded UI design.
- Create new features that the clients need to make the application custom for their business. 
- Translate design to pixel-perfect front-end code.
- Build responsive and interactive microsites on HTML5 / CSS3 and Javascript.
- Collaborate with creative and development teams to develop cross-product design solutions.
- Design and build interactive prototypes for applications that can be tested with customers.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Node.js · JavaScript · Web Development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Build cross-device advertising using mostly Celtra Ad Creator.
- Develop custom coded creatives using HTML/CSS, Restful API and JS.
- Create engaging experiences for the user like games, custom quiz, interactive media and more.
- Turn design into code.
- Create Tags and preview pages to display Celtra ads.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Node.js · JavaScript · Web Development

positions.title: Front End Developer / UI/UX Designer
positions.description:
- Create new features that the clients need to make the application custom for their business.
- Update the UI using technologies as HTML5, Bootstrap and Javascript.
- Resolve bugs found in the platform.
- Test the code developed.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Node.js · JavaScript · Web Development
